description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_Validate_EmailAddress, which provides email address validation functionality as part of the Zend Framework. It includes methods for validating email syntax, hostname, MX records, and local parts, with configurable options.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_EmailAddress
classes.description: A class that validates email addresses according to RFC standards, including syntax, hostname, MX records, and local part validation, with multiple configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes options for email validation, including hostname validator, MX checking, and domain check.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple validation options, such as hostname validator, MX validation, domain validation, and messages.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets a custom validation message for specific validation errors.

methods.name: setHostnameValidator
methods.description: Sets the hostname validator object and allowed hostname types.

methods.name: validateMxSupported
methods.description: Checks if the system supports DNS MX record validation via getmxrr.

methods.name: getValidateMx
methods.description: Returns whether MX record validation is enabled.

methods.name: setValidateMx
methods.description: Enables or disables MX record validation for email addresses.

methods.name: getDeepMxCheck
methods.description: Returns whether deep MX checking is enabled.

methods.name: setDeepMxCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables deep MX validation.

methods.name: getDomainCheck
methods.description: Returns whether domain validation is enabled.

methods.name: _isReserved
methods.description: Checks if a hostname corresponds to a reserved IP address range.

methods.name: _toIp
methods.description: Converts a binary string to an IP address in array form.

methods.name: _validateLocalPart
methods.description: Validates the local part of the email address against dot-atom and quoted-string formats.

methods.name: _validateMXRecords
methods.description: Validates the MX records for the hostname to ensure they are routable and exist.

methods.name: _validateHostnamePart
methods.description: Validates the hostname part of the email, including DNS validation and MX validation if enabled.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Main method to validate whether the input string is a valid email address according to RFC standards. Checks format, local part, hostname, and optional DNS/MX records.
